title: luzula lutea
intro: Luzula lutea, commonly known as Golden Woodrush, is a perennial plant species within the genus Luzula in the family Juncaceae. It is native to the mountainous regions of Europe, particularly in the Alps and the Carpathian Mountains. The health benefits of Luzula lutea include its use as an anti-inflammatory and antiseptic agent, helping to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties.
